fields.description: One B Tower is Wasl’s residential development on Sheikh Zayed Road, beside the Dubai Water Canal. Apartments and duplexes share a podium pool, fitness spaces and places for families to gather. Wasl associates the tower with the One Billion Meals Endowment initiative.
